notes.title: “By grace you have been saved through faith”
notes.intro: One of the best-loved summaries of salvation, followed by “created to do good works” (v. 10).

views.label: Grace through faith alone, with works following
views.summary: Protestants see here salvation as God’s gift received by faith alone, with good works as its fruit (v. 10).

views.label: Grace through faith, beginning in baptism and lived in love
views.summary: Catholics fully affirm that salvation is a free gift of grace that cannot be earned, received through faith and baptism, and bearing fruit in good works by grace.

views.label: Grace with which we cooperate
views.summary: Orthodox Christians stress that salvation is entirely God’s gift, and that people freely respond and cooperate (synergy).
views.source: Fr Thomas Hopko, The Orthodox Faith, vol. 4

notes.common: All Christian traditions agree salvation is by God’s grace and is not earned.
